title: Yellowed Vegetable Biryani
description: A flavorful and aromatic vegetarian biryani dish made with yellowed vegetables, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is a twist on the classic Malaysian biryani.

ingredients.name: Yellowed vegetables (such as carrots, corn, and peas)

instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the onion, ginger, and garlic and sauté until the onion is translucent.
Add the yellowed vegetables, red chili, turmeric, cumin, and coriander.
Add the rice and stir well.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-12 minutes.
Fluff the rice with a fork.
Optional: Garnish with chopped almonds and serve hot.
